    • cleanupOfWaterloggedStackKeepsTheWater

      public static void cleanupOfWaterloggedStackKeepsTheWater(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce: V-place a temporary Storage Stack into a water source and extract its only item. Settlement removes the empty block and the water source remains.

    • playerCausedCleanupCarriesThePlayer

      public static void playerCausedCleanupCarriesThePlayer(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      To reproduce: in a claim that admits a player but denies [SomeStacks], extract the last item from a temporary Storage, Singles, and Bar Stack, and toggle an empty permanent Storage pile back to temporary. Each empty block is removed on the player's behalf, so the claim allows it and logging mods record the player. Extracting one of two Storage items by hand and the other by automation before settlement attributes the cleanup to [SomeStacks] instead, so that claim keeps the empty block.

    • placementGrowthAndCleanupNotify

      public static void placementGrowthAndCleanupNotify(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player, Consumer<net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> placeGesture)
      To reproduce: put a sculk sensor near a floor, V-place Storage holding dirt, fill its slots, and deposit stone to grow it. Extract the stone and let settlement trim the upper block. Each structural edit produces its placement or destruction vibration, subject to ordinary sculk filtering. Inventory edits alone do not produce these structural events.
